facts.text: In 21 BBY, the planet served as a site of a Clone Wars engagement, where the Galactic Republic task force of Jedi General Aayla Secura was attacked by a Confederacy of Independent Systems squadron of frigates commanded by the T-series tactical droid TF-1726.

evidence.quote: In 21 BBY, the planet served as a site of a Clone Wars engagement, where the Galactic Republic task force of Jedi General Aayla Secura was attacked by a Confederacy of Independent Systems squadron of frigates commanded by the T-series tactical droid TF-1726.

facts.text: During the battle, the Republic forces were inflicted with heavy casualties as the Confederacy claimed victory.

evidence.quote: During the battle, the Republic forces were inflicted with heavy casualties as the Confederacy claimed victory.
